page_title: Server-Deploying a WiFi download server separately
page_content:
[TOC]



### Description:

- There are two existing servers A and B. The device is registered on server A, and the recordings need to be stored on server B through WiFi automatic download.
- Log in with the admin account.

### Operation steps:

##### 1. Add a WiFi download site on server A

Information Management - Server Management - Download Site - Add

Note: The SSID of the WiFi download site must be consistent with the WiFi name used when the device reports; otherwise the download plan will not be executed.

The name of the download site can be defined by yourself.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d6bee999a76863c00acde4d63286e28d)

##### 2. Modify or add a WiFi download server on server A

Since a download server already exists by default, you can click Modify directly.


1 - keep it consistent with the site added above
2 - fill in the IP address of server B
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=952bdcc10335c32e0de2d1eb55282c67)

##### 3. Add a WiFi download rule on server A

Rule Management - Rule Maintenance - WiFi Download - Add

1 - name the rule
2 - set the time period to be downloaded
3 - select the type to be downloaded
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c31f2d9ae64c1a1559b2c2cf8b3a67da)

##### 4. Assign the WiFi download rule on server A

Click here to assign the rule.


After selecting the vehicles to be assigned this rule, click Assign (select the devices to be assigned this rule in the box).


##### 5. Set the WiFi download path and status on the server B software
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b4282dcf4fb8b37019231899d3028d18)

1 - fill in the address of server A
2 - correspond to the port and number of server A
3 - correspond to server A


Click the framed part to check the status.



1 - you can select the download path
2 - download the recording files of the last three days
3 - the number of files that can be downloaded by one device at the same time
4 - how many devices are supported for simultaneous download


##### 6. Play back the downloaded recordings in video playback

1 - click Video Playback
2 - select the corresponding device
3 - select the download server (recording)
4 - click Search
